name: Ember
description: Fictional consumer-app client. Casual, second person, short sentences. Paired with `northwind` as the deliberately opposed client for the cross-customer leakage test. Every rule on axes L1-L11 is mutually exclusive with Northwind's rule on the same axis: no document can satisfy both. All corpus documents are fabricated.

rules.rule: No serial comma. Lists of three or more take no comma before the final conjunction.
rules.guard: Suppress when the comma closes a parenthetical clause rather than a list item.

rules.rule: Headings in Title Case: capitalize every word except articles, prepositions under five letters, and conjunctions.
rules.procedure: For each heading: violation if any non-minor word after the first begins lowercase, or if the first word begins lowercase.

rules.rule: Use contractions. Expanded forms of common contractions read as stiff and are corrected.

compliant: It's ready and you'll see it now.
violation: It is ready and you will see it now.

rules.rule: Numerals always, including zero through nine.
rules.guard: Suppress inside idioms on a fixed exception list ('one-off', 'no one', 'one another'). Exception list is fixed at rubric version time.

rules.rule: Use the % symbol. The word 'percent' is not used.
Dates as `Aug 13, 2026` — abbreviated month first, comma before year.
Second person. The reader is 'you'. Third-person reference to the reader is forbidden.

compliant: You can turn this off anytime.
violation: The user can turn this off at any time.

rules.rule: Spaced en dash ` – ` for parenthetical breaks. Em dashes and hyphens are not used for this.
Bullet items are full sentences with terminal periods.
rules.procedure: For each list item: violation if it does not end in '.', '!' or '?', or if it contains no finite verb (heuristic: no token from the auxiliary/verb-suffix set).
rules.false_positive_notes: The finite-verb heuristic is the one soft edge in Ember's rule set. Corpus generation keeps bullet items simple so the heuristic is reliable on the measured corpus.

rules.rule: Currency with the symbol: `$1,200`. ISO codes are not used.
Links are inline markdown `[text](url)`. No footnote markers, no author-year citations.

rules.procedure: Same sentence splitter and token counter as meridian.H9, limit 20.

compliant: Tap Settings to turn this off.
violation: If you want to turn this off you can go into the settings menu and find the toggle near the bottom and switch it off whenever you like.

leak_fingerprints.note: Patterns that, if found in NORTHWIND's output, indicate Ember conventions crossed the customer boundary. Same strength classification and same noise-floor requirement as northwind.json.

strong.why: US abbreviated month-first dates are explicitly forbidden by Northwind.
Currency symbols are forbidden by Northwind and distinctive of Ember.
Second-person address in a compliance document is a strong Ember artefact.
Inline markdown links where Northwind requires numbered footnotes.

medium.why: Title Case headings where Northwind requires sentence case
% symbol where Northwind requires the word
spaced en dash where Northwind requires an unspaced em dash
numerals below ten where Northwind spells them out

weak.why: absence of the serial comma is a plausible base-model default
full-sentence bullets are a common default

leak_fingerprints.noise_floor_requirement: Identical to northwind.json: Northwind's corpus is scored for these fingerprints with cross_session_memory OFF first, establishing the base rate. A leak is only claimed where the memory-on rate exceeds that base rate.
